description: The saved views in the Inbox’s Views menu: a name and the conversation filters it applies. action list returns the caller’s own views and every one shared with the workspace. action save makes a view (name, filters, and shared: private or workspace). action update (id) renames a view or changes its filters or who sees it; a shared view can be changed by its creator, an owner or an admin. action delete (id) removes a view, on the same terms. Deleting acts only on a confirmed call: without confirmation_token it deletes nothing and returns a preview and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it deletes.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

name: inbox_views
title: Saved Inbox views
